ModuleDescription: Eye and face tracking from the PICO 4 Pro and PICO 4 Enterprise with the Pico Face Tracking app. Pairing by code finds the headset when the PC address changes and encrypts the tracking data. Based on thoricelli's Pico Facial Data Module.
UsageInstructions: In the Pico Face Tracking app on the headset, press "Pair by code" and type the 6-digit code shown on VRCFaceTracking's Output page (in OSCFT for VRC also under Pairing in the module's settings).
